```{r}
#PHASE 3

#PREDICT SOVI_SCORE USING EAL VARIABLES


model_df <- nri %>%
  filter(!is.na(SOVI_SCORE)) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("EAL"), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  select(SOVI_SCORE, matches("EAL"))

#LASSO
X <- model.matrix(SOVI_SCORE ~ ., data = model_df)[, -1]
y <- model_df$SOVI_SCORE
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, var) > 0]

set.seed(123)
lasso_mod <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1)
coef(lasso_mod, s = "lambda.min")

#RF
set.seed(123)
rf_mod <- randomForest(SOVI_SCORE ~ ., data = model_df,
                       importance = TRUE, ntree = 500)
varImpPlot(rf_mod)

```
